about: Milestone N2 of ADR 0012, engine waits and time: the catalogue cases of FX-23 to FX-29, recorded on the CE oracle by the fixtures below, which N2 wrote and whose runs its exit gate runs on windmill-lite; each case is recorded by a run or deferred with a milestone and a reason. FX-24/d and /e need a loop and gate NI, whose fixture control-flow/cf-27 records them; FX-24/g's in-process executor is later; the delays of FX-26/c to /e are hours long, beyond what a recording waits for, and the walker does not capture a queued job's scheduled time, so N2's unit tests check them on the recording clock (internal/engine, TestRetryDelay and TestEngineRetryDelays); FX-29/c is recorded by milestone N5's fixture flows/control-flow/subflow-retry, outside this batch. TestRecordingBatches enforces it.

deferred.reason: a collapsed loop's timeout needs a for loop (N3a) and N2's timeout; NI is the first milestone with both, and its fixture flows/control-flow/cf-27 records the case (run fx24_d, ni.json)
a parallel loop's timeout needs a for loop (N3a) and N2's timeout; NI is the first milestone with both, and its fixture flows/control-flow/cf-27 records the case (run fx24_e, ni.json)
an in-process executor's timeout (later); the native boundary's text is C3n's (WR-44)
a first delay of 9464 s: the recording would wait hours, and the walker does not capture a queued job's scheduled time; checked at unit level on the recording clock
a delay of 21600 s: the recording would wait hours, and the walker does not capture a queued job's scheduled time; checked at unit level on the recording clock
a second delay of 21600 s: the recording would wait hours, and the walker does not capture a queued job's scheduled time; checked at unit level on the recording clock

source-derived in the reference's revision of 2026-10-29 (SC3): the jitter's distribution, a delay of 6 to 14 s whose single values are not reproducible, and the walker does not capture a queued job's scheduled time; docs/design/README.md requests a recording that samples it about 20 times from a future batch E3f. N2's unit tests check the arithmetic (internal/engine TestRetryDelay: p drawn from [0, 50), up or down) and the default jitter's range and both signs (TestSeededJitter). Recorded by batch E3f (conformance/flows/execution/fx-26-delays, run delays; internal/oracle/testdata/batches/e3f.json).

oracle-observed in the reference's revision SC4 (2026-10-29), from a fixture outside this batch: milestone N5's flows/control-flow/subflow-retry run exhausted_continue (oracle run 40915682847) records it, the same run as CF-17/d; no run of this batch records it. After a retried flow step runs out of attempts under continue_on_error, the next step's Success entry lists the step's failed first attempt as its own. N5's gate runs that fixture on windmill-lite (cmd/wltest TestSubflowRetryFixturesFreshAndWarm)
